assignments.title: Divide & Conquer vs Dynamic Programming Case Study

flashcards.question: What is the time complexity of QuickSort in the Average and Worst cases?
flashcards.answer:
Average Case: O(n log n)
Worst Case: O(n²) (when pivot selection is always the maximum or minimum element in an already sorted array).

flashcards.question: State the Principle of Optimality in Dynamic Programming.
flashcards.answer: An optimal solution to any instance of an optimization problem is composed of optimal solutions to its sub-problems.

flashcards.question: What is the difference between a Vector, a Matrix, and a Data Frame in R?
flashcards.answer:
• Vector: 1D homogeneous elements
• Matrix: 2D homogeneous elements
• Data Frame: 2D heterogeneous elements (columns can have different data types).

flashcards.question: What are ACID Properties in database transactions?
flashcards.answer:
• Atomicity: All or nothing
• Consistency: Valid state before and after
• Isolation: Concurrent transactions don't interfere
• Durability: Committed changes survive crashes.

flashcards.question: What is CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing)?
flashcards.answer: An HTTP-header based security mechanism that allows a server to indicate any origins other than its own from which a browser should permit loading resources.
